items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I made quite a few things for Billie. Arrangements, and I played piano for her.

ctx.x: Billie Holiday at the Grant Terrace. Do you know her first couple of weeks there, she flopped? That's how square they were in Chicago, they didn't understand her, but after they -- it began to grow on them. She tore it up there, and she won everybody. In fact, I remember one night, we were at the Grant Terrace. This is the Grant Terrace that finally moved from 35th and Giles over to 39th and South Park. This is where Ed Fox moved into a building there. And Billie Holiday --
This was a ball room type.
